title: Aerial Hammock Basic - 10 Beginner Tricks | aerial practice

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher introduces 10 basic beginner aerial hammock tricks with clear visual demonstrations and verbal walkthroughs. She guides the viewer from warmups on the floor and hammock to sequential trick breakdowns.

lesson_structure.note: Welcomes viewers and introduces 10 basic beginner aerial hammock tricks
Demonstrates warm-up stretches and exercises on a mat and with the hammock
Demonstrates tricks 1 through 10 with verbal explanation

steps_taught.name: Flipping into the hammock
steps_taught.description: Standing below rigging, bring knees to chest and flip back to land in the hammock.

steps_taught.name: Sitting position
steps_taught.description: Put one leg through the hammock, bend and straighten legs to sit up.

steps_taught.name: Mermaid pose
steps_taught.description: Open arm and move hip to mermaid pose.

what_works: Numbered tricks make it easy to follow along
Voiceover explains body positioning clearly during movement
what_hinders: No slow-motion replay of complex transitions

quotes.text: I'm sharing with you 10 basic beginner aerial hammock tricks.
The first trick is flipping into the hammock.
I'm straightening my legs and bringing my body up.
